Subject: Re: CAIQ session slotting and evidence delegate roster — notes and action items

Alex / Lumenix team — thanks again for the call today. Notes and actions below (60-minute CAIQ deep-dive, 2027-02-16).

Attendees: Alex Tran (Lumenix), compliance@lumenix.com, Mateo Alvarez (Redwood), Kimberly Park (Redwood), Irene Choi (Redwood)

Summary:
- Walked through high-risk CAIQ answers (network segmentation, key management, logging retention).
- Demonstrated redacted log pull and retention UI; confirmed 90-day default retention with configurable windows for Dedicated customers.
- Discussed KMS model: Redwood-managed keys by default; customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM available on Private plan.

Open questions raised on call (Q -> A):
1) Q: Can you provide a sample of audit logs that show operator role changes?
   A: Kim noted operator-change events are in the admin-audit stream; attached log bundle contains a synthetic example and we will export a two-week real sample by 2027-02-19. Owner: Kimberly Park.
2) Q: How are encrypted backups handled across regions?
   A: Irene clarified backups are encrypted in transit and at rest; cross-region replication uses envelope encryption and customer KMS options documented at account link. Owner: Irene Choi.
3) Q: SLA for evidence delivery during audits?
   A: We commit to 3 business days for targeted artifacts; longer migrations may take up to 10 business days. Owner: Mateo Alvarez.

Action items and owners:
- Kimberly Park: Export two-week admin-audit log sample (redacted) and upload to shared Drive by 2027-02-19. Attachment: redwood-admin-audit-sample-20270219.tar.gz
- Irene Choi: Provide KMS configuration sheet and backup replication diagram by 2027-02-18. File will be linked to Drive.
- Mateo Alvarez: Deliver mutual-action-plan PDF with owners/dates and update HubSpot (DW-2391) by 2027-02-17. File: mutual-action-plan-Redwood-Lumenix-2027-02-16.pdf

Follow-ups planned:
- Zoom recording and transcript will be shared to the Drive folder (link above).
- If Lumenix wants a short technical deep-dive on KMS or VPC peering, we can schedule a separate 45-minute session next week.

Thanks again — feel free to reply inline if anything is missing.

Best,
Mateo
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
